auth.key.title: Signing key
auth.key.intro: Every sign-in ticket and service token is signed with the keeper's key. A new key makes every application fetch it the next time it sees a ticket signed with it; tickets signed with the old one stop working at once, and sessions already open in applications are not affected.

auth.key.rotated: The signing key is new. Applications fetch it with the next ticket they see.
